entries.reason: Accepted design: reopen needs a done PASS acceptance and a real byte change, so rounds cannot be reset without an accepted PASS; local report JSON cannot authenticate time anyway.

Not a defect: a dependent's own accepted inputs are checked on every submit, and a dependency change that touches them warns with a reopen command. Flagging every dependent would be guard machinery for a rare case.
